question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing goalkeeper, and Claire is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Claire is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) goalkeeper
(C) striker
solution:
Positions in order: (Alice, Bob, Claire).
Initial: (right winger, goalkeeper, striker).
1. Bob and Claire swap: (right winger, striker, goalkeeper).
2. Bob and Claire swap: (right winger, goalkeeper, striker).
3. Bob and Claire swap: (right winger, striker, goalkeeper).
Claire is playing goalkeeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
